text:
Alex P.: Heads up — found a broken image link in the runtime guide that's showing a 403 in staging. Repro steps below, pinging docs owner. @docs-bot flagged it during link-scan :eyes:

so: docs-bot: [automated] link-scan detected 403 for https://staging-assets.redwood.ai/kb/runtime/diagram-v2.png - fingerprint id 9a7c

Alex P.: curl to reproduce:
```
curl -I https://staging-assets.redwood.ai/kb/runtime/diagram-v2.png
# -> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
```

Maya K.: Thanks — do we know which doc owns that path? It looks like the runtime guide includes it in /guides/runtime/latency.md

Chris L.: I think that image was added during the latency examples PR (gh#4282). The asset was uploaded to staging bucket with short-lived ACL. We need to rehost to the canonical CDN or change the frontmatter to use /static/hosted path.

Alex P.: Suggested quick fix: rehost image to cdn.redwood.ai and update markdown reference. Also add a redirect in the runbook if we can.

Rachel S.: Can someone open a small PR? I can approve once a CODEOWNERS entry is present. We should also add a one-line changelog in the doc frontmatter (changelog: asset swap).

Juan M.: I'm available to do the PR. Quick question: do we prefer a content-bucket push (scripts/infra/rehost.sh) or committing to the repo under /static/assets/runtime/?

Maya K.: For speed, commit under /static/assets/runtime/ and reference that path in the md. Ops can run a background job later to sync to CDN. Include a note in the PR description: "temporary rehost — follow-up: sync to CDN"

Alex P.: Example markdown change:
```
![runtime diagram](/static/assets/runtime/diagram-v2.png "runtime diagram v2")
```

Chris L.: Also add a comment in the PR linking the original staging URL and gh#4282 so we can audit later.

Juan M.: OK I'll open PR in ~30m, assign Maya and Rachel for review, and ping @ops for CDN sync.

Maya K.: thanks — also add a small test in the docs CI that asserts 200 on image path for staging-preview (helps avoid regressions).

docs-bot: [automated] Thread linked to issue: GH-5210 (docs: replace staging assets). New PR will auto-link when created.

Rachel S.: TY! If anyone hits permissions to push static files, ping me — can grant temporary permission.
